title: VoteRewards
description: Powerful vote rewards with streak tracking, vote parties, random rewards, and monthly leaderboards. Easy setup in under 5 minutes.
body:
# VoteRewards

  **Powerful as VotingPlugin, easy as SuperbVote.** The vote reward plugin that respects
  your time — full-featured out of the box, no PhD in YAML required.

  ## Why VoteRewards?

  Most vote plugins make you choose: powerful but complex, or simple but limited.
  VoteRewards gives you both — streak milestones, vote parties, weighted random rewards, and
   monthly leaderboards, all working from a clean default config the moment you drop in the
  jar.

  ## Features

  - **Vote Rewards** — Run commands, give items, send messages on every vote
  - **Vote Streak Tracking** — Reward players who vote consistently (3-day, 7-day, 30-day
  milestones)
  - **Vote Party** — Server-wide celebration when the community hits a vote threshold
  - **Random Rewards** — Weighted random loot (common/rare/legendary) on each vote
  - **Monthly Leaderboard** — Top voters reset each month, keeping competition fresh
  - **Offline Vote Queue** — Votes while offline are saved and delivered on next login
  - **PlaceholderAPI Support** — Full placeholder integration for scoreboards, holograms,
  etc.
  - **Vault Economy** — Give money rewards via any Vault-compatible economy plugin
  - **Fully Configurable** — Every message, reward, and threshold is customizable

  ## Commands

  | Command | Permission | Description |
  |---------|-----------|-------------|
  | `/votereward` | `votereward.use` | Show help menu |
  | `/votereward check` | `votereward.use` | View your vote stats, streak, and pending
  rewards |
  | `/votereward top` | `votereward.use` | View top voters this month |
  | `/votereward reload` | `votereward.admin` | Reload configuration |
  | `/votereward give <player>` | `votereward.admin` | Manually give vote rewards |
  | `/votereward party` | `votereward.admin` | Manually trigger a vote party |
  | `/votereward reset <player>` | `votereward.admin` | Reset a player's vote data |

  **Aliases:** `/vr`, `/vote`

  ## PlaceholderAPI Placeholders

  | Placeholder | Description |
  |-------------|-------------|
  | `%votereward_votes%` | Player's total all-time votes |
  | `%votereward_monthly_votes%` | Player's votes this month |
  | `%votereward_streak%` | Current vote streak (days) |
  | `%votereward_party_current%` | Current vote party vote count |
  | `%votereward_party_needed%` | Votes remaining until party |
  | `%votereward_top_N_name%` | Name of #N top voter |
  | `%votereward_top_N_votes%` | Vote count of #N top voter |

  ## Dependencies

  - **Required:** [NuVotifier](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/nuvotifier.13449/)
  (receives votes from vote sites)
  - **Optional:** [Vault](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/) (economy
  rewards), [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/)
  (placeholders)

  ## Installation

  1. Download the `.jar` file
  2. Place it in your server's `/plugins/` folder
  3. Restart your server
  4. Edit `config.yml` to customize rewards, streaks, and party settings
  5. Done — default config works out of the box

  ## Supported Versions

  Paper 1.20.x — 1.21.x (Java 17+)
